2608.06216.title: Continual Learning in Transition
2608.06216.paper_summary: Classical continual learning (CL) has primarily focused on enabling models to update and retain knowledge through parameter-centric mechanisms, e.g., training strategies, architectural designs, and weight adaptation. However, emerging paradigms are reshaping the scope of CL beyond this traditional model adaptation view. For instance, on-policy learning broadens the space of update mechanisms; test-time training extends CL from the training phase to inference; and external harness components such as memory, skill libraries, and interaction protocols extend the evolutionary boundaries of model capabilities far beyond the static parameter space. Collectively, these developments indicate a transition from parameter-centric learning toward system-level adaptation. To characterize this transition, we examine the evolution of continual learning through three dimensions: When, How, and Where learning occurs. The How dimension encompasses off-policy, on-policy, and beyond-gradient optimization mechanics. The When dimension captures evolution across pre-training, post-training, and inference-time stages. The Where dimension delineates updates occurring within internal parameters versus external structural constraints. Anchored by this tri-axial framework, we systematically survey representative methods, trace the ongoing transition of continual learning, and discuss the key challenges, broader implications, and future directions arising from this paradigm shift.
2608.06216.paper_summary_zh: 古典的持續學習（CL）主要專注於通過以參數為中心的機制來使模型更新和保留知識，例如訓練策略、架構設計和權重適應。然而，新興的範式正在重新塑造持續學習的範疇，超越這一傳統的模型適應視角。例如，策略內學習擴大了更新機制的空間；測試時訓練將持續學習從訓練階段延伸到推理；而外部輔助組件如記憶、技能庫和互動協議則將模型能力的進化邊界擴展到遠超靜態參數空間。總體而言，這些發展表明了一種從以參數為中心的學習向系統級適應的轉變。為了描述這一轉變，我們通過三個維度來檢視持續學習的演變：學習發生的何時、如何以及在哪裡。如何維度包括離策略、在策略和超越梯度優化的機制。何時維度捕捉了在預訓練、後訓練和推理階段的演變。在哪裡維度劃分了在內部參數與外部結構約束中發生的更新。以這一三軸框架為基礎，我們系統性地調查了代表性方法，追蹤持續學習的持續轉變，並討論了這一範式轉變所帶來的關鍵挑戰、更廣泛的影響和未來方向。
